input: Get my eyes tested for new glasses

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether the goal is just the eye test itself, or also choosing and ordering new glasses, determines how many steps the plan needs to cover.
Whether the user already has a preferred optician or needs to find one changes the first action entirely — searching vs. booking.
An urgency or deadline (e.g. prescription expiring, important event) affects how quickly to act and which appointment slots to prioritise.
Knowing how they prefer to book (phone, online, walk-in) determines the immediate next action to put in the plan.
Budget shapes whether to look at NHS-funded tests, private opticians, budget chains, or independent specialists, and how to approach the glasses purchase.
If this is for one person or multiple family members, the plan may need multiple appointments coordinated together.
The type of glasses needed (reading, distance, varifocal, contact lenses as an alternative) affects what to discuss with the optician and what to look for.

gold.taskTitle: Get eyes tested and new glasses
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to book and attend an eye test, with the likely goal of getting a new glasses prescription or pair of glasses.

questions.title: Is the goal just the test, or buying glasses too?
questions.description: Clarify whether the task ends at receiving a prescription or includes selecting and purchasing new glasses.

questions.title: Do you already have an optician you use?
questions.description: Determine whether the user needs to research and choose an optician or can go straight to booking.

questions.title: How soon do you need this done?
questions.description: Establish whether there is a deadline or urgency driving the timing of the appointment.

questions.title: How do you prefer to book the appointment?
questions.description: Find out whether the user wants to book online, by phone, or walk in, to shape the immediate next action.

questions.title: Are you looking to keep costs low or flexible on budget?
questions.description: Understand budget expectations to guide choice of provider and glasses options (NHS, budget chain, independent).

questions.title: Is this just for you or others in your household?
questions.description: Check whether multiple people need appointments so they can be coordinated together.

questions.title: What type of glasses do you think you need?
questions.description: Clarify the likely prescription need — reading, distance, varifocal, or whether contact lenses are also being considered.
